links.outcome: Whether post-hoc XAI methods highlight clinically meaningful ECG features for model decisions
links.effect: DeepLift, DeepLiftShap, and Occlusion consistently highlighted clinically meaningful features; LIME, KernelShap, and LRP failed to do so.
links.quote: Certain XAI methods, including DeepLift, DeepLiftShap, and Occlusion, consistently highlighted clinically meaningful features across abnormalities, while others, such as LIME, KernelShap, and LRP, failed to do so.

links.outcome: Model sensitivity and learned features when applying CODE-trained model to external PTB XL dataset
links.effect: Sensitivity above 0.9 for most abnormalities on external PTB XL, but the model struggled to capture clinically relevant features for some diseases.
links.quote: However, our XAI analysis showed that the model struggled to capture clinically relevant features for some diseases.

unlisted_practices: Ensemble majority-vote of post-hoc XAI methods to validate clinical relevance of attributions
Comparing XAI attribution relevance between correctly and incorrectly classified ECGs

screen.reason: Evaluates 16 post-hoc explainability (XAI) methods to determine whether they reliably surface clinically meaningful features and distinguish correct from incorrect ECG predictions.
